notes.title: Improved Load Times & WIndows 11 fixes
notes.content:
Our game doesn't load slowly! Your game loads slowly! We don't even have the time to make our game load slowly. Besides that, you can't prove it and the sheep are lying! 

[list]
[*]Fixed crash on Windows 11 on 12th gen Core 
[*]Improved level load times by 6 times and added a loading progress bar
[*]Reduced memory requirement on low-end systems
[*]Bug fix for Kitchen level unlock
[/list]

notes.title: UI bugs, kitchen celing, and more! Oh myyyy
notes.content:
Thank you to all our players reporting bugs! I'm happy to announce that all reported bugs are fixed in this release and we're now working on some performance improvements for low-end hardware for the next release!

* Fixed menu UI bug showing incorrect unlock status
* Made kitchen and bathroom level ceilings less sticky
* Fixed mouse resolution issue on Windows 11
